capabilities: Enrich the active note or all matching notes with Kinopoisk metadata
Detect whether a note is a film or TV series via a configurable property and value
Map API fields to properties separately for films and serials
Download and store poster images locally in configurable folders
Rotate multiple API keys and cache API responses as JSON in the vault
extras: The free Kinopoisk API tier allows 500 requests per day; the plugin is not reviewed by Obsidian staff, and update checks query GitHub releases.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up movie or TV series metadata from Kinopoisk and fill note properties automatically.

requires.name: Kinopoisk Unofficial API key from kinopoiskapiunofficial.tech

summary: Film metadata fetcher that enriches film and TV series notes with Kinopoisk data: descriptions, ratings, locally saved posters, and links.
